replyContent:
We thank you for sharing your review! We'd like to respond to the specific issues you mentioned.

1. Manual change of prayer time: You can easily set and adjust your alarm time from the home page. You can also set custom alarm times from the 'Alarm' tab!
2. Once an alarm is set, it will repeat on time everyday. So that feature is also available.
